summary: FX live-conversion feature tested end-to-end. Backend: all 9 pytest cases pass for /api/fx/convert (USD->DOP, EUR->DOP, identity, invalid code, auth required), /api/fx/rates (structure + cache), and /api/fx/refresh (admin allowed, non-admin 403). Frontend: FxConvertBadge correctly renders ≈ RD$4,403,105.92 below Base Salary when employee.currency=USD and companyCurrency=DOP, with data-testid='fx-convert-badge'. When currency matches company (DOP), badge is not rendered. Monthly Payroll header stays at RD$176,000.00 (no regression).
critical_code_review_comments: fx.py uses print() for upstream failure logging — consider logger.warning for prod observability.
convert endpoint accepts ge=0 but a 0-amount conversion is allowed; FxConvertBadge skips when amount is 0 (good guard on FE).
Cache TTL fallback: if a stale cached doc exists but upstream is down, get_cached_rates returns the stale doc — acceptable graceful degradation.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily set employees.currency='USD' for emp_91f4dfa58d68 (María González) to verify FX badge rendering, then reverted to 'DOP' at end of test. Final state: María's currency=DOP (original).
